description: Draft empirical envelope for FX top-of-book observables. All targets are derived from the existing Layer-1 fit and event audit on EURUSD spot quotes (April 2021 – March 2022 daily concatenation; recommendation document: archive_empirical/Data output/EURUSD output/layer1/layer1_recommendation.md). This file is non-invasive: it does not replace targets/real_fx_envelope.json. It exists so that the comparison layer can later be invoked against a partially calibrated empirical envelope via simulator.envelope_bridge.merge_envelopes.
notes: Each empirical field carries placeholder=false and a 'source' key that names the empirical artefact it was derived from.

Simulator tick size is 1e-5 (default observation operator). The empirical spread audit is reported in pips (1 pip = 10 ticks at tick_size = 1e-5). Spread targets below have been converted from pips to ticks.
Empirical EURUSD totals are pooled across the full UTC day; rates are events per second.
The 4-type alphabet matches the simulator's EventType enum exactly: 0 = bid_up, 1 = bid_down, 2 = ask_up, 3 = ask_down.

latent.total_rate.notes: Empirical EURUSD pooled rate across the four directional event types over the full UTC day. Tolerances kept loose because the simulator's first-milestone default has rate ~2.0; this empirical target is roughly half that and a strict warn_rel would push every shipped configuration to fail without delivering scientific information.

latent.rates_by_event_type.source: archive_empirical/Data output/EURUSD output/eurusd_event_audit.csv (rate_per_s_global rows for bid_up, bid_down, ask_up, ask_down)
latent.rates_by_event_type.notes: Per-component empirical rate vector. Empirically symmetric to within sub-percent; the simulator's symmetric configuration is consistent with the structure of this target if the absolute scale is matched.

endogeneity.spectral_radius.notes: Spectral radius of the empirically fitted 4-type exponential Hawkes branching matrix on EURUSD 20 July 2021 with random_ms jitter. Tier-2 (bivariate mid) gives 0.597; the recommended Tier-3 sum-of-exp gives 0.988 on the primary day. The 4-type single-exponential value is the most directly comparable to the simulator's exponential-kernel default. The first-milestone default (0.2) is well outside warn_abs and would warn under this target — that is the empirical reality, not a simulator bug.

observation.spread_mean_ticks.source: archive_empirical/Data output/EURUSD output/eurusd_event_audit.csv (_spread_summary_ row, spread_pips_mean = 0.380; converted at 1 pip = 10 ticks for tick_size = 1e-5)
observation.spread_mean_ticks.notes: Empirical mean spread on EURUSD across the full audit window, expressed in ticks at the simulator's default tick_size = 1e-5. Real EURUSD is consistently within a few ticks of one pip; the simulator spreads are sub-diffusive in N_obs and sit in the 8-15-tick range on the shipped configurations, which is loose but the same order of magnitude.

observation.spread_median_ticks.notes: Empirical median spread in ticks. Robust to tail excursions.

observation.spread_p99_ticks.notes: Empirical 99th-percentile spread in ticks. Sensitive to tail events; tolerances set wide to accommodate session-of-day variation that the audit pools over.

observation.spread_max_ticks.notes: Empirical maximum spread observed in the audit window. The max grows with sample size and is highly path-dependent; tolerances are deliberately loose. This field is informational rather than gating.

observation.num_crossed_observations.source: structural invariant of the censor policy (no empirical source required)
observation.num_crossed_observations.notes: Hard invariant. Mirrors the placeholder envelope; not an empirical target but a structural one.
